column1: # The LAST row must be the terminal row: declaration `*`, expecting
# "(exports clean)".  It asserts the walk is COMPLETE — that with exactly the
# preceding declarations neutralised the tree exports with no refusal left.
# Without it a truncated plan would walk its rows, pass every one, and say
# nothing about the frontier it never reached.  frontier.py refuses a plan
# that does not end this way, and re-checks the final state in its exit code.
